element.key: Drag the items and pack your backpack to attend the Atlas Festival.
Not everything you see can be taken with you. Your logic and care for the comfort of other visitors will tell you what is better to leave at home.
This is a counter that will show how many of the allowed items you have already taken with you. Don’t forget — you need to fit everything that is allowed!
Time never stands still. You need to complete the task within the allotted time, otherwise — try again.
Our items are already charged with Atlas energy and can’t wait to get to the festival! So don’t be surprised if they have trouble staying in one place.
Bring the item to the rotation zone to rotate it on its axis, because fitting all the allowed items can be quite difficult.
Contact our support team to resolve the issue.
